decisionStatus: Eight complete cursor-helper declarations pass against the local Node helper in the working tree. Final-head bootstrap, runtime/browser checks and independent/configured reviews are separate required integration gates. No MCP, storage, UI or lifecycle parity is established by this unit suite.

substitutions: Dedicated trash helper instead of shared upstream repository types; the active-list context-qualified cursor remains separate.
UTF-8 standard-base64 helper branches are colocated, with decodeBase64Bytes inlined into decodeBase64.
InvalidCursorError adds readonly code INVALID_CURSOR for local native envelope metadata; class name, validation and truncated message remain unchanged.
preserved: Decoder rejects empty input directly and input longer than 4096 before decoding.
Only string orderValue and id are required; empty fields, arbitrary values and extra context remain permitted.
No timestamp, ID-format, collection or locale validation is added.
Both native Uint8Array and fallback btoa/atob branches retain upstream encoding semantics.
